opening.argument: The presentation concerns Tesla stock and electric-vehicle market developments, including a JP Morgan analyst’s reported $864 price target and a forecast that global EV sales will reach 15% by 2030 from 2% currently. Although the speaker describes his own practice as holding and buying more, he expressly states, “I don't recommend anything,” while the description says, “I do NOT give any recommendations on buying, selling or holding Stocks.” It further makes clear that “Buying stocks is your choice and responsibility.” The evidence therefore supports market commentary with an explicit limitation on recommendations, not deceptive claims, guaranteed returns, required payment, or data submission.
